youtube-thumbnail.prefix: bold YouTube thumbnail composition, strong focal subject, high contrast, readable empty space for title text,
youtube-thumbnail.negative: small unreadable text, clutter, watermark, low contrast

character-portrait.prefix: game character portrait, clear silhouette, expressive face, consistent costume details, neutral background,
character-portrait.negative: extra limbs, cropped face, duplicate features, watermark

pixel-art.prefix: clean pixel art sprite, limited color palette, crisp hard edges, game-ready asset,
pixel-art.negative: blurry pixels, anti-aliasing, photorealistic texture, watermark

item-icon.prefix: single centered game item icon, readable silhouette, transparent-background composition, polished inventory asset,
item-icon.negative: busy background, multiple objects, text, watermark

environment-concept.prefix: game environment concept art, clear foreground middle ground and background, production-friendly shapes,
environment-concept.negative: text, watermark, muddy composition, distorted perspective
